αἰακίδαο: Αἰακίδης — descendant of Aeacus, here Achilles (grandson of Aeacus); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’)
αἴτιος: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. sg.
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐγὰς: αὐγή — ray, gleam, light; fem. acc. pl.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ · also intensive, ’the very men themselves’ (with a following τε … τε) · also ’ourselves’, first person, coordinate with another object (νῆάς τε καὶ αὐτούς ’both the ships and ourselves’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δίκας: δίκη — custom, right, judgment; fem. acc. pl.: ‘judgments’, not yet the abstract ‘justice’
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δαπέδῳ: δάπεδον — level ground, floor, pavement; neut. dat. sg. (τυκτῷ δαπέδῳ ’on the wrought, levelled floor’)
δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially
διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg. · also δίδωμι ’give’: aor. subj. 1 sg., ’I may give’ (ἵνα τοι δῶ ’that I may give you’)
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’
εἴδωλον: εἴδωλον — phantom, image, likeness (esp. a dream-figure sent by a god); neut. nom./acc. sg.
εἴροντο: ἐρέομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they asked’
εἴσβαινον: εἰσβαίνω — go aboard, embark; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἰσέβαινον)
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg. (εἶδον ’I saw’) · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they saw’
εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’made’ (ἀνάπυστα θέσαν ’made known’)
θέσκελα: θέσκελος — marvellous, wondrous (origin uncertain, perhaps ’god-spoken’); neut. acc. pl.
θανὼν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having died, now dead’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, prodigious, superhuman in scale; fem. dat. sg. (ἠχῇ θεσπεσίῃ ’with a wondrous outcry’)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη)
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’
καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀλετρεύουσι: ’grain’ · also ’fruit’ (λωτοῖο … μελιηδέα καρπόν ’the honey-sweet fruit of the lotus’)
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατέπεφνεν: πέφνω (defective, found only in the aorist) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. of the compound κατα-πέφνω: ’slew’
κατατεθνηώτων: καταθνήσκω — die; perf. part. masc. gen. pl., epic -ηώτων (= Attic κατατεθνεώτων): ’dead’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’)
κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘lying’
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κεχολωμένος: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’enraged’
κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κληῖσι: κληΐς — thole-pin, oarlock (also ’key, bolt’ elsewhere); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι · also ’rowing-bench, thwart’ (ἐπὶ κληῖσι καθῖζον ’sat down on the rowing-benches’)
κρατέρ: κρατερός — mighty, strong, harsh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρατέρ’ = κρατερά)
κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, genitive of separation: ’from his head’ · also in ἐπὶ κρατὸς + gen., ’at the head, top’ (ἐπὶ κρατὸς λιμένος ’at the head of the harbour’)
κυλίνδετο: κυλίνδω — roll; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’was rolling’
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
λᾶαν: λᾶας — stone, rock; masc. acc. sg. (Attic λίθος)
λῦσαι: λύω — loose, untie; aor. inf.: ’to loose (the stern-cables)’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέλαινα: μέλας — black, dark; fem. nom. sg.
μένον: μένω — wait, wait for; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg. (same form), intransitive: ’I remained, stayed’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’with long (steps)’ (μακρὰ βιβάς ’striding with long steps’)
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μελέων: μέλος — limb; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελῶν): ’of the limbs’
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be furious, rage; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
μηλέαι: μηλέα — apple tree; fem. nom. pl.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μυρία: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl. μυρία · also neut. nom. pl. (identical form), agreeing with a nominative: ’countless’ (ὀνείατα μυρία κεῖται)
μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέφεα: νέφος — cloud; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νέφη)
νεκρῶν: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. gen. pl.
νεκύων: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. gen. pl.
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv.
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἰωνῶν: οἰωνός — bird of omen; gen. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg.
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.
οὖρος: οὖρος — a fair wind, favorable wind; masc. nom. sg. · also a different word, related to ὁράω ’see, watch’ — warden, guardian; masc. nom. sg. (οὖρος Ἀχαιῶν ’warden of the Achaeans’)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’)
παγχάλκεον: πάγχαλκος — all of bronze; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic παγχάλκεος (= Attic παγχάλκους)
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
παράκοιτιν: παράκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πελώριον: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; neut. nom. sg.
πελώρου: πέλωρος — monstrous, huge; as noun πέλωρον ’monster’; neut. gen. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περσεφόνεια: Περσεφόνεια — Persephone, queen of the dead; fem. nom. sg.
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
ποδώκεος: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — many-devising; voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
ποσίν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., dat. of means or respect: ’with the feet’
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’) · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they addressed’ (ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδων)
πρυμνήσια: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πύργος: πύργος — tower, city wall; masc. nom. sg.
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ) · also gen. of comparison: σεῖο … μακάρτατος ’more blessed than you’
σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, dim; neut. acc. pl.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
σμερδαλέος: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dread, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
συκέαι: συκέη — fig tree; fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic συκαῖ)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τεῒν: σύ — you (sg.); epic dat. sg. τεΐν (= Attic σοί)
τηλεθόωσαι: τηλεθάω — flourish, be luxuriant; pres. part. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τηλεθῶσαι)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τινὰ: τις, τι — someone, something, anyone; indef. pron., masc./fem. acc. sg.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τιτυὸν: Τιτυός — Tityos, a giant, son of Earth; masc. acc. sg.
τοίην: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. acc. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’ · also demonstrative with a noun, ’that’, antecedent of a relative: ἄνδρα τόν, ὅς κε … ’that man who …’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
χέε: χέω — pour, spread; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχεε)
χερσί: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl. (without movable ν)
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, fresh (of living wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also of honey, neut. acc. sg.: ’yellow, pale’ (μέλι χλωρόν ’yellow honey’) · also of fear, neut. nom. sg.: ’pale’ (χλωρὸν δέος ’pale fear’)
χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; adj., neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν)
ψυχαὶ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. pl.
ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
ψυχὴ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. sg.
ἀέθλους: ἄθλος — trial, contest, ordeal; masc. acc. pl., uncontracted epic ἄεθλος (= Attic ἄθλους)
ἀίδαο: Ἀΐδης (Ἅιδης) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου): ’of/in Hades’ house’
ἀίδεω: Ἀΐδης — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀγαυὴ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Persephone
ἀγλαόκαρποι: ἀγλαόκαρπος — bearing splendid fruit; fem. nom. pl.
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant, bright; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀμβαίνειν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard; pres. inf., epic ἀμβαίνειν (ἀνα- apocopated to ἀμ- before β), as an instruction
ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’)
ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg.: ἀμύμονα Λαοδάμαντα ’blameless Laodamas’
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’mounted’); acute kept before an enclitic
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg.
ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; adj., neut. acc. sg. used substantively: ‘the headland’ · also neut. acc. sg. ’the tip, the end’ (of a stake)
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλλας: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’
ἐκεῖνος: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron. (full form, beside the shortened epic κεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
ἐκπάγλως: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, vehement; adv. ἐκπάγλως: ’terribly, vehemently’
ἐλαῖαι: ἐλαία — olive tree; fem. nom. pl.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐρικυδέα: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, splendid; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἑκάστη: ἕκαστος — each, each one; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; nom. sg.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι)
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμελλες: μέλλω — be about to, be going to (+ inf.); impf. 2 sg.: ’you were going to’
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔρεβος: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark of the underworld; neut. acc. sg.
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔφην: φημί — say, declare; impf. 1 sg., augmented, ἐ- before the consonant-initial stem φη-: ’I said’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; pluperf. 3 pl., intransitive, with simple past force: ’were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg.
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I brought’ (ἤγαγον ἐκ Σκύρου ’I brought him from Scyros’)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἤχθηρε: ἐχθαίρω — hate, be hostile to; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἤχθηρε: ’hated’
ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic ἥμενος: ’sitting’
ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. nom. sg., with οὔρεϊ: ’equal to a mountain’
ὀιζὺν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλοφυρόμενος: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; (intrans.) arise, spring up; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had sprung up’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’)
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj., here introducing a vivid simile
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄγχναι: ὄγχνη — pear tree; fem. nom. pl.
ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὠρίωνα: Ὠρίων — Orion, the constellation; masc. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’)
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized’
ῥίπτασκε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), unaugmented: ’would throw’
ῥοιαὶ: ῥοιά — pomegranate tree; fem. nom. pl.
ῥόπαλον: ῥόπαλον — club, cudgel; neut. nom. sg.
